stylingAndBuild.name: next-env.d.ts
stylingAndBuild.summary: Auto-generated Next.js ambient type declaration file that pulls in the `next` and `next/image-types/global` type references so TypeScript understands framework globals and image imports. Not meant to be hand-edited.

stylingAndBuild.name: next.config.mjs
stylingAndBuild.summary: Next.js framework configuration that tunes the built-in image optimizer, preferring WebP over AVIF (AVIF softens JPEG portraits at default quality) and declaring a custom device-size breakpoint ladder up to 3840px.

stylingAndBuild.name: package.json
stylingAndBuild.summary: Package manifest for the private `anuraag-web` portfolio, declaring the standard Next.js dev/build/start/lint scripts and pinning the runtime stack: Next 14.2, React 18, framer-motion, next-themes, lucide-react, react-github-calendar and the Tailwind class utilities (clsx, tailwind-merge).

stylingAndBuild.name: postcss.config.mjs
stylingAndBuild.summary: Minimal PostCSS configuration registering Tailwind CSS as the sole plugin, which is what expands the `@tailwind` directives and `@apply` rules in the global stylesheet during the build.

stylingAndBuild.name: globals.css
stylingAndBuild.summary: Global stylesheet that loads the three Tailwind layers and defines the site's light/dark design tokens as raw RGB channel triples (`--tw-canvas`, `--tw-ink`, `--tw-line`, ...) on `:root` and `.dark`. Also supplies the decorative `.grain` SVG-noise and `.wash` gradient overlays, wavy-underline treatment, custom selection colors and theming for the GitHub contribution-calendar tooltips.

stylingAndBuild.name: tailwind.config.ts
stylingAndBuild.summary: Tailwind design-system configuration: enables class-based dark mode, scopes content scanning to src/app, src/components and src/pages, and extends the theme with CSS-variable-backed semantic colors (canvas, surface, ink, line), a pastel and accent palette, three font families, soft/card/lift shadows, and float/wiggle keyframe animations.

stylingAndBuild.name: tsconfig.json
stylingAndBuild.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the Next.js project: strict mode with `noEmit` (Next handles transpilation), bundler module resolution, preserved JSX, incremental builds, the `next` language-service plugin, and the `@/*` path alias mapping to `./src/*`.

list.name: Routing & Pages
list.description: Next.js App Router route segments — the home/hero page plus the contact, projects and experience pages that compose components and read typed content data to render each URL.

list.name: Application Shell & Chrome
list.description: The persistent frame wrapped around every route: the root layout and page-transition template, plus global navigation, footer, theme context/toggle, scroll progress and the ambient backdrop and cursor glow effects.

list.name: Motion Primitives
list.description: Generic, content-agnostic Framer Motion wrappers under src/components/motion — reveal-on-scroll, magnetic hover, tilt cards and staggered split headlines — reused across pages and feature components.

list.name: Presentational Components
list.description: Portfolio-specific display widgets built on the motion primitives — the hero portrait, rotating greeting, GitHub contribution graph, experience timeline progress indicator and decorative wavy rule.

list.name: Content Data
list.description: Typed, statically-authored site content in src/content — the project catalogue and work-experience entries that stand in for a CMS or database in this static portfolio.

list.name: Shared Utilities
list.description: Dependency-free helpers in src/lib: the Tailwind class-merging utility and the scheduled light/dark theme calculation consumed by the theme provider.

list.name: Build & Styling Configuration
list.description: Project-level toolchain and design-token setup — Next.js, PostCSS, Tailwind and TypeScript configuration, the dependency manifest, generated Next type declarations, and the global stylesheet defining theme CSS variables.

file:src/app/layout.tsx.name: layout.tsx
file:src/app/layout.tsx.summary: Next.js App Router root layout that loads the three Google fonts as CSS variables, declares site-wide SEO/OpenGraph metadata, and wraps every page in the theme provider along with the persistent nav, footer and ambient visual layers.

file:src/components/AmbientBackdrop.tsx.name: AmbientBackdrop.tsx
file:src/components/AmbientBackdrop.tsx.summary: Purely decorative fixed background layer that paints four blurred pastel blobs and a masked dot grid behind all page content, with separate opacities for light and dark mode.

file:src/components/CursorGlow.tsx.name: CursorGlow.tsx
file:src/components/CursorGlow.tsx.summary: Client component that renders a soft pastel radial glow which lazily trails the pointer across the page, with separate light and dark gradients, and disables itself for reduced-motion users and non-fine pointers.

file:src/components/Footer.tsx.name: Footer.tsx
file:src/components/Footer.tsx.summary: Site footer showing the current-year copyright, external links to GitHub, LinkedIn and the hosted résumé, and a playful sign-off line with an animated tilde.

file:src/components/Nav.tsx.name: Nav.tsx
file:src/components/Nav.tsx.summary: Fixed, blurred top navigation bar with the wordmark, four route links whose active item is highlighted by a shared-layout animated pill, the theme toggle, and the scroll progress hairline.

file:src/components/ScrollProgress.tsx.name: ScrollProgress.tsx
file:src/components/ScrollProgress.tsx.summary: Two-pixel gradient bar pinned to the bottom edge of the nav that scales horizontally with the page's scroll progress, smoothed by a spring.

file:src/components/ThemeProvider.tsx.name: ThemeProvider.tsx
file:src/components/ThemeProvider.tsx.summary: Custom theme layer that owns an auto/light/dark preference persisted to localStorage, re-evaluates the clock-scheduled theme on a timer and on tab visibility changes, and feeds the resolved theme into next-themes as a forced theme.

file:src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx.name: ThemeToggle.tsx
file:src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx.summary: Round sun/moon button in the nav that pins light or dark on click and returns to clock-scheduled auto mode on Alt+click, rendering a neutral placeholder until the theme preference has hydrated.

file:src/lib/scheduledTheme.ts.name: scheduledTheme.ts
file:src/lib/scheduledTheme.ts.summary: Single-function module encoding the site's time-of-day theme schedule: light between 06:00 and 19:00 local time, dark otherwise.

file:src/lib/utils.ts.name: utils.ts
file:src/lib/utils.ts.summary: Shared class-name helper module exposing the `cn` utility used across every component for conditional Tailwind styling.

file:src/app/contact/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:src/app/contact/page.tsx.summary: Next.js App Router route for /contact, rendering a mailto card plus magnetic GitHub, LinkedIn and résumé links wrapped in scroll reveal animations.

file:src/app/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:src/app/page.tsx.summary: Home page of the portfolio, composing the animated hero (rotating greeting, split headline, tilting portrait), a two-project 'Selected work' grid and the GitHub contribution graph.

file:src/components/ContributionGraph.ts.name: ContributionGraph.tsx
file:src/components/ContributionGraph.ts.summary: Renders the author's last-year GitHub contribution calendar in the site's lilac palette, scaling the fixed-width calendar to exactly fill its container.

file:src/components/HeroPortrait.tsx.name: HeroPortrait.tsx
file:src/components/HeroPortrait.tsx.summary: Hero photo card with offset pastel backing layers and a cursor-tracked radial shine highlight that springs toward the pointer on hover.

file:src/components/RotatingHi.tsx.name: RotatingHi.tsx
file:src/components/RotatingHi.tsx.summary: Small hero greeting that cycles through four intro lines every 4.2 seconds with an animated enter/exit transition.

file:src/components/motion/Magnetic.tsx.name: Magnetic.tsx
file:src/components/motion/Magnetic.tsx.summary: Reusable motion primitive that makes its children drift toward the cursor while hovered and spring back on leave, used for buttons and pill links across the site.

file:src/components/motion/Reveal.tsx.name: Reveal.tsx
file:src/components/motion/Reveal.tsx.summary: Reusable scroll-reveal primitive that fades and lifts its children into place as they enter the viewport; the most widely reused animation wrapper in the site.

file:src/components/motion/SplitHeadline.name: SplitHeadline.tsx
file:src/components/motion/SplitHeadline.summary: Headline primitive that splits text into individual characters and staggers each one rising into place, with a per-letter hover lift.

file:src/app/projects/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:src/app/projects/page.tsx.summary: App Router page for the /projects route that renders every entry from the shared projects content module as a responsive two-column grid of image-led cards with tech-stack stickers and external links. Composes the Reveal, TiltCard and WavyRule motion primitives around otherwise static server-rendered markup.

file:src/components/WavyRule.tsx.name: WavyRule.tsx
file:src/components/WavyRule.tsx.summary: Client component providing a decorative horizontal divider drawn as a soft SVG wave that animates its stroke into view on scroll. Used as a section separator across the home, contact, experience and projects pages.

file:src/components/motion/TiltCard.tsx.name: TiltCard.tsx
file:src/components/motion/TiltCard.tsx.summary: Client-side motion wrapper that applies a subtle spring-damped 3D tilt to its children as the cursor moves across them. Used to add depth to project and experience cards.

file:src/content/projects.ts.name: projects.ts
file:src/content/projects.ts.summary: Single source of truth for portfolio project entries, exporting a typed `Project[]` array with name, period, subtitle, description, cover image, tech stack and external links for each project. Consumed by both the projects page and the home page.

file:src/app/experience/page.tsx.name: page.tsx
file:src/app/experience/page.tsx.summary: Next.js App Router server page for the /experience route that renders the career timeline by mapping over the typed `roles` content array into logo, title, date-range and highlight cards. file:src/components/TimelineProgress.tsx.name: TimelineProgress.tsx
file:src/components/TimelineProgress.tsx.summary: Client component providing the vertical timeline rail that fills with an accent gradient as the user scrolls past the role list it sits beside. Respects the user's reduced-motion preference by omitting the animated fill entirely.

file:src/content/experience.ts.name: experience.ts
file:src/content/experience.ts.summary: Typed content module defining the `Role` shape and exporting the `roles` array — the newest-first list of jobs with company, location, date range, summary, highlight bullets and logo path — that drives the experience timeline UI.
